transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Um... well, my head just feels kind of foggy lately. I've been... making little mistakes in my client notes at work. Just forgetting what I was about to do. It's not really like me, so... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... lately I just wake up with this... heavy feeling. Kind of empty in my chest. I mean, I can still get through my shifts fine, talking to people and doing my job... but inside, I just feel kind of... I don't know. Sad. Just flat, really.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
Um... I don't think so. I mean, I still do the same things I usually do. Just... watching TV after work, normal stuff. I haven't really noticed a change with that.
Did something stressful happen in your life around the time this fogginess started?
Um... I guess so. My uncle passed away... it was about two weeks ago. I think that's when this all started.
Do you find yourself thinking a lot about your uncle’s death?

Yeah... I guess I do. Um... I just keep thinking about what I should have done for my tío. Like... I should have called him more, or gone to visit him sooner. I don't know. I just... I feel like I let him down. Like I wasn't a good nephew.
Do these feelings mostly come up when you think about your uncle?
Um... yeah, probably. I mean... I try not to dwell on it, but... I guess so. It's mostly then.
Are there moments when your mood lifts and you can feel okay for a little while?

Um... not really. I mean, I can get through my shifts at work okay... talk to people and do my job. But... I don't know. Lately I just wake up with this heavy feeling in my chest. Like it's just empty. So even if I'm doing things, inside I just feel... sad. Just flat, I guess.
Have you been worrying a lot about many different things, not just your uncle?
Um... no, not really. Just... mostly just him. I mean, regular stuff sometimes, but... no, not a lot of different things. Just... the usual.
Have you been waking up earlier than usual and unable to fall back asleep?

Um... yeah, I guess. My sleep has just been kind of... all over the place lately. Sometimes I just lie there in the dark thinking about... family stuff. Or I'll wake up a while before my alarm is supposed to go off, and... I just can't really settle back down after that.
Have you noticed your appetite has decreased lately?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I still eat about the same, I guess. Just... normal.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?

Yeah... I guess so. My head just feels kind of... foggy lately. I've been making some little mistakes at work... in my client notes. Or I'll just... forget what I was about to do. It's not really like me, but... yeah.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?

Yeah... a bit, I guess. My body just feels kind of... worn out lately. Even on days I don't really do much. Just... simple stuff, like helping a client shower, or carrying the groceries. It just takes more out of me than it should.
Have you been feeling this sad and heavy nearly every day for the past two weeks?

Yeah... I suppose so. Pretty much every day. It's just... I wake up and there's this heavy, empty feeling right here in my chest. I mean, I still get through my shifts, I talk to my clients and everything. But inside... it's just sad. Kind of flat, you know? Just... yeah.
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual lately?
Um... no, not really. I haven't noticed anything like that. I mean... I just go about my day normal, I guess. Nobody at work has said anything to me about it. So... no.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?

I don't know about worthless... just... guilty, maybe. I've been thinking a lot about my tío. He passed away recently, and... I don't know. I just keep replaying things in my head. Like I should have called him more, or gone to see him sooner. I just feel like I... like I let him down. Like I failed him, as family. So, yeah... I guess I've been feeling pretty bad about that.
Do you feel like a failure as a person, not just in relation to your uncle?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I do my job fine. It's mostly just... what I already said. About my tío. That's it.
Have you been having a hard time making decisions lately?

Um... I don't know about decisions, exactly. Mostly my head just feels... foggy. I've been making these little mistakes in my client notes at work. Or I'll just forget what I was about to do. It's... not really like me. But... yeah, just foggy.
Have you been feeling unusually cold lately?
No... not really. I mean, just normal, I guess. I haven't noticed being cold.
Have you been forgetting recent conversations or appointments?
Um... no. Not that I've noticed. I mean, I still show up to my shifts on time. It's just the... the notes, like I said. But no, I haven't missed any appointments or anything.
Have you still been able to laugh or feel a little better at times?
Um... I guess so. I mean, I still laugh at things sometimes. Just... normal stuff. I don't know if I feel better, exactly, but... yeah, I can still laugh.
